program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    candidates = [value for value in counts if value not in (0, background)]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = min(candidates, key=lambda value: counts[value])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    mask = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    mh, mw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
